summary: HUHUTECH International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a registered direct offering. The company issued 400,000 ordinary shares at US$1.50 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 1,600,000 ordinary shares at US$1.4999975 per warrant, for aggregate gross proceeds of US$3 million. The warrants are immediately exercisable at US$0.0000025 per share and expire when fully exercised. Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction with no special-situations or structural complexity, and no acquisition, restructuring, or other event-driven catalyst.
